text: {"lessons":["My account rose overall despite several setbacks, which reminds me that one month’s movement is not a reliable guide to the next.","Making no trades avoided impulsive reactions, but I should still review whether my holdings and risk remain suitable rather than equating inaction with a plan.","Because losses affect me strongly and I trade infrequently, I should set a measured long-term approach and avoid letting short-term declines dictate decisions."]}
